layers.deciding_comparison: Compare narrowly provisioned Matt + Trail + ECC against Matt + Trail + Vercel on clean WSL2 x86_64 and macOS arm64, using pinned sources, identical clients/models and a frozen mix of general engineering and frontend tasks. Also compare Matt tdd directly with ECC tdd-workflow on matching tasks. Retain discovery results, installed components, loaded sections, concrete findings, correctness, context cost, instruction conflicts and effort against a minimal baseline before adding another pack. The present selection follows complementary capability fit; measured superiority is unresolved.
evidence_gaps: The packet contains no comparison where every named arm ran. Verified repository CI suites differ substantially and cannot establish comparative agent task quality.

Clean-host installation, discovery and invocation were not executed. Text/Node/Python portability supports an expectation of Linux and macOS compatibility; WSL2 and macOS arm64 execution remain unverified. This instruction layer requires no GPU.
Install commands compose documented Git checkout and skills CLI local-source options. Skill sources are pinned; the npm installer invoked with @latest is not pinned.
Native ECC skill selection can expand to a parent module; its minimal profile also includes agents, commands and configuration. Exact-directory installation avoids relying on that profile's breadth.

Correction verified in original source: ECC's Claude-only qualifier applies to --locale, not --skills. Astra/Max review accepted complementary roles and this correction; it did not establish measured superiority.

Automatic approval review rejected ctx_fetch_and_index because it requires approval and the session policy is never. Public documentation was instead retrieved through GitHub API responses, indexed with ctx_index and read with ctx_search.
